name: coord-jump
description: Browser extension: highlight text containing latitude/longitude and jump straight to it in Google Maps

scripts.start:firefox: web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files test scripts dist package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.package: node scripts/build.js && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename coord-jump-{version}-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename coord-jump-{version}-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest
